mapper.sql: select version_id, biz_key, content_hash, payload, first_sync_time, first_sync_time_utc, last_sync_time, last_sync_time_utc, hit_count, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark from ${tableName}
mapper.select: select version_id from ${tableName} where biz_key = #{bizKey} and content_hash = #{contentHash}
mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (biz_key, content_hash, payload, ${c.column}, first_sync_time, first_sync_time_utc, last_sync_time, last_sync_time_utc, hit_count, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark) values (#{v.bizKey}, #{v.contentHash}, #{v.payload}, #{c.value}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), 1, #{v.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{v.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{v.remark})
mapper.select: t where t.biz_key != '-' and not exists (select 1 from ${tableName} x where x.biz_key = t.biz_key and (x.last_sync_time > t.last_sync_time or (x.last_sync_time = t.last_sync_time and x.version_id > t.version_id))) order by t.biz_key desc
select distinct biz_key from ${tableName} where biz_key != '-'
mapper.insert: insert into option_info_sync (info_key, biz_key, http_status, result, version_id, raw_bytes, cost_ms, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time) values (#{infoKey}, #{bizKey}, #{httpStatus}, #{result}, #{versionId}, #{rawBytes}, #{costMs}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour))
